Cricket selectors face dilemma over opening batsman selection

Former India cricketer Cheteshwar Pujara has publicly supported Sanju Samson for an opening batsman position, stating he will get an opportunity at the right time. The selection debate also involves Vaibhav Suryavanshi. Sunil Gavaskar has also weighed in on the selection, supporting a particular player and making a significant comment about Shreyas Iyer.
